# Data Science Pipeline

Enables a full data science pipeline including preprocessing, feature engineering, and ML training.

## Usage
- Automates data cleaning, transformation, and feature engineering
- Supports model training with scikit-learn, XGBoost, and PyTorch
- Performs hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation
- Generates evaluation reports with metrics and learning curves
